$comment: Legends design tokens: the single source for Tailwind (web/) and Flutter ThemeData (mobile/). Values come from the design system board (legends-ui/Main.dc.html), and since X32 (2026-10-25) Legends' own signature after the owner asked for colours of our own: night ink (bg, panel), emerald (brand) for bands, table heads and the current section, gold for the calls to action and the coach's row, mint rings (ring) and ivory tabs (chrome) instead of the management games' blue and silver. Since X56 (2026-10-29) a day theme too: colorLight overrides the grounds and the text on html.light, and ink darkens the accents' text there. Change here first, then regenerate both.

colorLight.$comment: The day theme (X56, the owner's request 2026-10-29), on html.light: only the colours that change. The ground turns to warm paper and the ink to our night navy; the accents (gold, emerald, red) stay as they are for fills, and their text takes the darker ink below, so a gold word stays readable on paper. The match broadcast stays at night (.theme-night).

ink.$comment: The day theme's text in an accent colour (text-gold, text-success...): the same hue, dark enough for 4.5:1 on paper. At night the text takes the accent itself.

font.$license: Alexandria (Mohamed Gaber, SIL Open Font License; X100, 2026-11-05, in place of Amin): a variable font served from web/public/fonts (woff2, one file per script: Arabic, Latin, Latin Extended). Barlow Condensed: SIL Open Font License, from Google Fonts, for the scores and counters.

match.$homeSide: RTL: the home team sits on the right of the score bug, so the score string reads away-home left to right.
